_om: Engelsk översättning av spelarsidan.json. Bara texter; siffrorna står i den svenska filen.

spelarsidan.klassval_inledning: The tower lays out its cards. Choose one before the time runs out, or the tower will choose for you.
spelarsidan.topp_vantar_redo: waiting for all to be ready
spelarsidan.tecken_liv: Lives: {liv} of {max}. At nought you are dead.
spelarsidan.tecken_kraft: Strength {n}: how easily you hit in a fight.
spelarsidan.tecken_forsvar: Defence {n}: how hard you are to hit.
spelarsidan.tecken_skatt: Treasure: {guld} gold. It only counts if you carry it out through a gate.
spelarsidan.tecken_dryck_en: One potion. {tryck} to drink it. It gives back lives and draws out poison.
spelarsidan.tecken_dryck_flera: {n} potions. {tryck} to drink one. It gives back lives and draws out poison.
spelarsidan.tecken_kallare: In the cellar vaults. No one sees where you are, and you come up somewhere else.
spelarsidan.tecken_fast_en: Held fast for {n} round. You cannot leave here.
spelarsidan.tecken_fast_flera: Held fast for {n} rounds. You cannot leave here.
spelarsidan.tecken_gift: Poisoned. You lose lives every round until the poison passes. A potion draws it out.
spelarsidan.tecken_morker: The lantern is out. You see only the room you stand in, but not its doors: you must feel your way.
spelarsidan.tecken_namndelar: Signs of a name that you have found in the tower, in the order you found them, not in the order of the name. The dots are the ones you are missing. Where on the serpent each part sat is told where you found it.
spelarsidan.tecken_tom_plats: An empty place in your bag. You can carry {max} items.
spelarsidan.hjalp_sok: Ssearch the room, or take treasure in the chamber
spelarsidan.hjalp_zoom: Zchange zoom: room (on a phone), near, middle, far, all
spelarsidan.hjalp_tips: Hold the mouse over the signs at the top right to see what they mean.
spelarsidan.minikarta_namn: The minimap: everything you have discovered
spelarsidan.minikarta_titel: Click to see everything you know on the map. K hides the minimap.
spelarsidan.karta_utan_webgl: The map cannot be drawn here, because this browser lacks WebGL. The log and the Now panel work as usual.
spelarsidan.nu_vaknakort: Waking cards left in the deck: {antal}
spelarsidan.slut_valj: Choose a wanderer to read how they got their gold.
spelarsidan.slut_ai: ~ AI played part of the way
spelarsidan.vandring_pagar_en: The walk goes on: round {runda}, the sun is one hand-breadth above the horizon. {inne} still in the tower, {ute} gone out.
spelarsidan.vandring_pagar: The walk goes on: round {runda}, the sun is {sol} hand-breadths above the horizon. {inne} still in the tower, {ute} gone out.
spelarsidan.vandring_tom: Nothing happened that the tower remembers.
spelarsidan.vandring_vantar: When the walk is over, the whole chronicle will be here.
spelarsidan.nu_strid_tangenter: A attack · Space keep your guard up
spelarsidan.nu_tornet_styr: The tower guides your steps. Choose a move to take them back.
spelarsidan.nu_ute: You are out with {guld} gold. Waiting for the others.
spelarsidan.nu_ute_tom: You are out, without gold. Waiting for the others.
spelarsidan.nu_fast_en: You are stuck for one more round
spelarsidan.nu_fast: You are stuck for {n} more rounds
spelarsidan.knapp_vardsidan_tips: You are the game master. The host page opens in this tab, and Join yourself there brings you back.
spelarsidan.knapp_vardsidan_ny_flik: The host page opens in a new tab. You stay in the game and are not counted as absent.
spelarsidan.natet_hittar_inte: Cannot find the tower. Check that the link is complete and that the Keeper has the tower open.
spelarsidan.natet_fel: Could not load what is needed to reach the tower. Reload the page.
